title: Handley Page Halifax JB863
memorial_details:
Black, rectangular, marble tablet mounted at a low, oblique angle on a low, brick-built plinth. The dedication is in gold, raised, upper and lower-case letters. A picture of a Halifax bomber is top centre of the tablet.

The memorial is erected by the community of Elvington, indicating a strong local connection.
inscription: TO THE MEMORY OF/ (names)/ MEMBERS OF 77 SQUADRON FROM ELVINGTON WHO LOST THEIR/ LIVES IN A HALIFAX BOMBER WHICH CRASHED NEAR THIS SITE/ DURING TAKEOFF ON A BOMBING MISSION TO LE CRUESOT FRANCE/ 10.06 PM 19TH JUNE 1943/ THEY GAVE THEIR TODAY FOR OUR TOMORROW
